OPERATOR_REQUIRED: operator rights required on this host
INVALID_TIMEFRAME: invalid timeframe; allowed: hour day week month year
GIT_PROVIDER_UNAUTHORIZED: invalid or expired GitHub token (401) — check GITHUB_TOKEN in settings
GIT_PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: GitHub rate limit reached (403) — configure a GITHUB_TOKEN to raise the limit
GIT_PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: repository not found on GitHub (404) — check owner/repo
ALERT_INCIDENT_RESOLVE_FAILED: rule updated, but resolving its open incidents failed
ALERT_DOCKER_HOST_NOT_FOUND: host not found for this Docker scope
ALERT_DOCKER_CONTAINER_NOT_FOUND: Docker container not found for this scope
ALERT_COMPOSE_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND: Compose project not found for this scope
ALERT_PROXMOX_CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND: Proxmox connection not found for this scope
ALERT_PROXMOX_NODE_NOT_FOUND: Proxmox node not found for this scope
ALERT_PROXMOX_STORAGE_NOT_FOUND: Proxmox storage not found for this scope
ALERT_PROXMOX_GUEST_NOT_FOUND: Proxmox VM/LXC not found for this scope
ALERT_PROXMOX_DISK_NOT_FOUND: Proxmox physical disk not found for this scope
ALERT_ROLLING_WINDOW_NOT_ALLOWED: the rolling-average window does not apply to this metric
ALERT_COOLDOWN_NEGATIVE: the silence period must be zero or positive
ALERT_ESCALATION_NEGATIVE: the escalation delay must be zero or positive
ALERT_COMMAND_TRIGGER_INCOMPLETE: a command trigger must define both a module and an action
ALERT_METRIC_REQUIRES_PROXMOX: this metric requires a Proxmox source
ALERT_TEMPLATE_METRIC_NOT_HOST_SCOPED: Docker, Proxmox and synthetic metrics cannot be used in a template — they do not apply host by host
RUNBOOK_STEPS_REQUIRED: a runbook must have at least one step
